failureMessage: the recognition API and speechSynthesis live on window, which a service worker has none of — referencing them there throws or reads undefined, so the listen or speak silently never happens

matchLines.what: constructs or references the Web Speech recognition API in the MV3 service worker
matchLines.fix: move the listening half to a content script, side panel, popup or offscreen document — recognition needs a document

matchLines.what: references speechSynthesis in the MV3 service worker, where it is undefined
matchLines.fix: speak from the worker with chrome.tts (extension-only, needs the "tts" permission); reserve speechSynthesis for a document context

failureMessage: Chrome exposes recognition only under the webkit prefix and other contexts may expose neither, so the bare prefixed constructor throws a ReferenceError wherever that global is absent

matchLines.what: constructs the webkit-prefixed recognizer directly with no unprefixed SpeechRecognition fallback
matchLines.fix: resolve the constructor once via `globalThis.SpeechRecognition ?? globalThis.webkitSpeechRecognition` and gate an availability flag on it existing, so absent-API contexts degrade to a no-op

failureMessage: a page frozen into the bfcache is suspended, not destroyed, so a live recognizer or getUserMedia stream keeps the microphone on until a pagehide handler stops it

repoWide.what: opens the microphone (getUserMedia / a speech recognizer) but no source file releases the capture on `pagehide`
repoWide.fix: add a `pagehide` listener that aborts the recognizer and stops getUserMedia tracks — it fires on unload AND bfcache freeze, unlike beforeunload; an offscreen-document capture earns an accept with a reason
